market_summary: Nifty rose 0.58% to 25,291 and Sensex 0.63% to 82,103 on Mon 16 Nov, led by FMCG (+1.9%) and private banks, while pharma, metals, auto and realty fell 1.2-1.7% and breadth was weak (about 1,400 stocks up, 2,800 down). Foreign investors bought a provisional ₹4,865 cr and domestic funds sold ₹3,519 cr, taking November foreign buying to about ₹79,300 cr; India VIX rose 1.3% to 15.70. Today is Nifty weekly expiry with the index looking stretched, and the main results season ended on 14 Nov, so few notable results are due.

buy_ideas.name: Deepak Fertilisers and Petrochemicals
buy_ideas.target_source: TradingView average of 2 analysts (range ₹1,790-1,900); Trendlyne consensus ₹1,897. No fresh broker note after Q2 yet.
buy_ideas.thesis: Q2 profit up 85% to ₹394 cr on revenue up 11% to ₹3,334 cr; EBITDA up 62% to ₹750 cr and margin up about 7 percentage points to 22.5%. Shares jumped about 8% to ₹1,362 on 16 Nov but remain well below the August high of ₹1,681. The analyst average implies about 35% upside.
buy_ideas.risks: Already up 8% in one day, so a pullback is possible. The targets come from only two analysts and predate these results; the only recent named note (Keynote, June) was Neutral at ₹1,534. Net debt is ₹4,743 cr, and chemical and gas prices swing.

buy_ideas.name: ABB India
buy_ideas.target_source: Motilal Oswal (upgraded to Buy from Neutral)
buy_ideas.thesis: September-quarter revenue up 19% to ₹3,738 cr and profit up 8-11% to about ₹440 cr, in line with estimates. Record order inflow of ₹4,733 cr (+56%) lifts the backlog 36% to ₹12,927 cr. Motilal expects profit to grow about 31% a year through CY28. The stock slipped about 2% on 16 Nov, so the target is now about 19% above the price.
buy_ideas.risks: Expensive at about 60 times 2028 earnings. Profit growth this quarter was modest, and the price is implied from the ₹7,045 close on 13 Nov minus the 2% fall, so check the live quote.

buy_ideas.name: Apollo Hospitals
buy_ideas.thesis: Q2 revenue up 20.8% and profit up 32%, both above estimates. Hospital stocks led on 16 Nov (Apollo +2.9% to ₹8,771, Max +6.6%, Fortis +5.1%) as investors moved to defensives. About 19% upside to target.
buy_ideas.risks: Valuation is high and new hospitals take time to fill. The rally in hospital stocks could cool after a strong day.

buy_ideas.name: Minda Corporation
buy_ideas.thesis: Q2 revenue up 43% and profit up 69% year on year; revenue beat estimates by 10.7%. Growth from EV parts and digital displays. About 26% upside to target.
buy_ideas.risks: No fresh price today; the price is implied from the 11 Nov upside. Auto stocks fell 1.3% on 16 Nov and small caps 1.1%, so it may have slipped. Mid-cap, so it swings more.

Results missed: Q2 profit fell about 62% to ₹45 cr and the stock dropped about 13% on 16 Nov. Wait for it to settle.
